start.title: A Famine in the Land
start.text:
A severe famine strikes the land of Canaan.
What do you do?

choices.text: Go down to Egypt to live there as a foreigner for a while
choices.feedback: Genesis 12:10 — Now there was a famine in the land, and Abram went down to Egypt to live there for a while, for the famine was severe.

choices.text: Sail across the sea to a distant island
choices.feedback: Genesis says Abram went down to Egypt during the famine.

choices.text: Stay in Canaan and lead an army
choices.feedback: Genesis says Abram went to Egypt because of the famine.

road_south.title: As You Near Egypt
road_south.text:
You are about to enter Egypt.
What do you say to your wife Sarai?

choices.text: 'I know what a beautiful woman you are — the Egyptians will kill me to take you'
choices.feedback: Genesis 12:11-12 — 'I know what a beautiful woman you are. When the Egyptians see you, they will kill me but will let you live.'

choices.text: 'The Lord will protect us; we have nothing to fear'
choices.feedback: Genesis says Abram was afraid and did not trust openly; he devised a plan.

choices.text: Say nothing at all to Sarai
choices.feedback: Genesis records the words Abram spoke to Sarai about his fear.

fear_rises.title: The Request
fear_rises.text:
You ask Sarai to do something to protect your life.
What is it?

choices.text: 'Say you are my sister, so that I will be treated well because of you'
choices.feedback: Genesis 12:13 — 'Say you are my sister, so that I will be treated well for your sake and my life will be spared because of you.'

choices.text: 'Say you are my mother, so no one will notice'
choices.feedback: Abram asked Sarai to say she was his sister.

choices.text: 'Say we are strangers who have never met'
choices.feedback: Abram's half-truth was to call her his sister.

the_lie.title: The Egyptians See Sarai
the_lie.text:
You arrive in Egypt.
How do the Egyptians respond to Sarai?

choices.text: The Egyptians see that she is very beautiful
choices.feedback: Genesis 12:14 — When Abram came to Egypt, the Egyptians saw that Sarai was a very beautiful woman.

choices.text: The Egyptians ignore her completely
choices.feedback: Genesis says the Egyptians noticed how beautiful she was.

choices.text: The Egyptians drive her away from the city
choices.feedback: The Egyptians praised her beauty; they did not drive her away.

entering_egypt.title: Pharaoh's Officials
entering_egypt.text:
Pharaoh's officials see Sarai.
What do they do?

choices.text: They praise her to Pharaoh, and she is taken into his palace
choices.feedback: Genesis 12:15 — When Pharaoh's officials saw her, they praised her to Pharaoh, and she was taken into his palace.

choices.text: They chase Abram out of Egypt at once
choices.feedback: Genesis says Sarai was taken into Pharaoh's palace, not that Abram was chased out.

choices.text: They ignore her and offer no attention
choices.feedback: Pharaoh's officials praised her beauty to the king.

officials_come.title: For Sarai's Sake
officials_come.text:
Because of Sarai, Pharaoh treats you well.
How does he treat Abram?

choices.text: He gives you sheep, cattle, donkeys, servants and camels
choices.feedback: Genesis 12:16 — He treated Abram well for her sake, and Abram acquired sheep and cattle, male and female donkeys, male and female servants, and camels.

choices.text: He puts Abram in prison
choices.feedback: Genesis says Pharaoh gave Abram many gifts for Sarai's sake.

choices.text: He gives Abram nothing at all
choices.feedback: Genesis lists the many gifts Abram received.

sarah_taken.title: The Lord Strikes
sarah_taken.text:
The Lord does not remain silent.
What does He do because of Sarai?

choices.text: The Lord inflicts serious diseases on Pharaoh and his household
choices.feedback: Genesis 12:17 — But the Lord inflicted serious diseases on Pharaoh and his household because of Abram's wife Sarai.

choices.text: The Lord sends fire down on Egypt
choices.feedback: Genesis says the Lord sent serious diseases, not fire.

choices.text: The Lord remains silent
choices.feedback: Genesis says the Lord acted; He struck Pharaoh's house.

gifts_arrive.title: Pharaoh Summons You
gifts_arrive.text:
Pharaoh calls for you.
What does he say?

choices.text: 'What have you done to me? Why didn't you tell me she was your wife?'
choices.feedback: Genesis 12:18 — 'What have you done to me? Why didn't you tell me she was your wife?'

choices.text: 'Thank you for your gifts — please stay'
choices.feedback: Pharaoh rebuked Abram; he did not thank him.

choices.text: 'Sarai will remain in my house forever'
choices.feedback: Pharaoh returned Sarai to Abram.

plagues.title: Take Her and Go
plagues.text:
Pharaoh gives his order.
What does he command?

choices.text: 'Here is your wife. Take her and go!'
choices.feedback: Genesis 12:19 — 'Now then, here is your wife. Take her and go!'

choices.text: 'You must remain here as my servant forever'
choices.feedback: Pharaoh sent Abram away with Sarai.

choices.text: 'I will keep Sarai and you may return to Canaan alone'
choices.feedback: Pharaoh returned Sarai to Abram.

confronted.title: Escorted Out
confronted.text:
Pharaoh gives orders about you.
What happens?

choices.text: Pharaoh's men send you on your way, with your wife and everything you have
choices.feedback: Genesis 12:20 — Then Pharaoh gave orders about Abram to his men, and they sent him on his way, with his wife and everything he had.

choices.text: Pharaoh's men strip you of all your possessions
choices.feedback: Genesis says Abram left with his wife and everything he had.

choices.text: Pharaoh's men put you in chains
choices.feedback: Genesis says Pharaoh's men sent Abram on his way in peace.

expelled.title: Going Up from Egypt
expelled.text:
You leave Egypt.
Where do you go?

choices.text: Go up from Egypt to the Negev, with your wife and all you have
choices.feedback: Genesis 13:1 — So Abram went up from Egypt to the Negev, with his wife and everything he had, and Lot went with him.

choices.text: Stay in Egypt and settle there for good
choices.feedback: Genesis says Abram went up from Egypt.

choices.text: Go east across the desert to Assyria
choices.feedback: Genesis says Abram returned to the Negev, in the land of promise.

altar.title: Back to the Altar
altar.text:
You return to the place between Bethel and Ai,
to the altar you had built at first, and there you call on the name of the Lord.
